主要内容: On March 13, 2015, Jeffrey A. Cook, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Treasurer of Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc., notified the company of his intention to retire effective April 3, 2015. The company has initiated a search for his replacement. Robert J. Cardin, the Controller of the company, will assume Cook's duties until a replacement is identified. Additionally, Stephen Dunmead, Chief Operating Officer of the company, notified the company of his intention to resign effective April 15, 2015. Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the company, Mr. Villoutreix, will assume Dunmead's duties. There are no immediate plans to find a permanent replacement for Dunmead. The company issued a press release on March 18, 2015, announcing these senior management changes.
